channel.description: Last 10 notes on Dong Xing's Blog

item.title: Subsequence Automaton
item.description: The Subsequence Automaton is a data structure that maintains a string s in \Sigma^* by maintaining a deterministic finite automaton that accepts and only accepts subsequences of s.

item.title: Borůvka's Algorithm
item.description: Borůvka’s Algorithm is an algorithm that computes the weight of the minimum spanning tree of a connected undirected graph G=\langle V,E\rangle with edge weights in \mathcal{O}(|E|\log|V|) time and \mathcal{O}(|E|) space.

item.title: Kruskal's Algorithm
item.description: Kruskal’s Algorithm is an algorithm that computes the weight of the minimum spanning tree of a connected undirected graph G=\langle V,E\rangle with edge weights in \mathcal{O}(|E|\log|E|) time and \mathcal{O}(|E|) space.

item.title: Counting Sort
item.description: Counting Sort is an algorithm that sorts a sequence of n integers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1}\in\{0,1,\dots,m-1\} in non-decreasing order in \mathcal{O}(n+m) time and \mathcal{O}(m) space.

item.title: Insertion Sort
item.description: Insertion Sort is an algorithm that sorts a sequence of n numbers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1} in non-decreasing order in \mathcal{O}(n^2) time and \mathcal{O}(1) space.

item.title: Euler's Sieve
item.description: Euler’s Sieve is an algorithm that finds the primes in 2,3,\dots,n in \mathcal{O}(n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.
